purpose: Before-results prospective comparison of original V5 versus a predeclared historical-pace challenger; never silently rerank or claim success.
before_any_race: Obtain full date-matched official starters (including actual emergencies), final weights/claims/barriers and official going as published before each race start.
Obtain dated independent form for every starter, including pre-race historical 800m settlements, source identity and as-of timestamp.
Prevent race-level 600m split records from being labelled horse_specific; do not invent individual speed.
Calculate and independently freeze unchanged baseline and candidate for the entire verified active field before scheduled jump, with commit SHA, timestamp, model code hashes and official-source URL.
Withhold a scored prospective evaluation if a winner was missing from the original frozen starter field, race started before freeze, or inputs were revised after result.
notice: This manifest registers the hypothesis, not the racecard or any predictions. It cannot be counted as a prospective success without independently dated pre-jump forecasts.
